premium.script:

perp = source(close, type=perp)
// aggregate spot vs aggregate perp basis, in bps (scale-free across regimes)
prem = (spot - perp) / perp * 10000
cloudarea(prem, 0, title=Premium)

keltner.name: Keltner Channel
keltner.script:
price = avg_ohlc(bar)
close = avg_close(bar)

range = price.high - price.low
averageRange = sma(range, options.length)

basis = ema(close, options.length)
dev = options.mult * averageRange
upper = basis + dev
lower = basis - dev

plotline(basis, color=options.basisColor)
plotcloudarea(lower, upper)

delta-spot.name: Delta Spot
delta-spot.script:
_vbuy = source(vbuy, type=spot)
_vsell = source(vsell, type=spot)
volume = _vbuy+_vsell
a = sma(Math.pow(volume,2),options.length)
b = Math.pow(sum(volume,options.length),2)/Math.pow(options.length,2)
stdev = Math.sqrt(a - b)
avg = sma(volume, options.length)
dev = options.mult * stdev
treshold = avg + dev
delta = _vbuy - _vsell

plothistogram({ time: time, value: (delta), color: delta > 0 ? ( volume > treshold ? options.upColorHighVol : options.upColorLowVol) : ( volume > treshold ? options.downColorHighVol : options.downColorLowVol)}, title="Δ Spot")

absorption.script:
// Passive absorption detector.
// Bull (green, up): bar closed UP while net delta was NEGATIVE on elevated volume
//   -> market sells hit resting bids and price still rose = passive accumulation
// Bear (red, down): bar closed DOWN while net delta was POSITIVE on elevated volume
//   -> market buys hit resting offers and price still fell = passive distribution
p = avg_ohlc(bar)
dir = p.close - p.open
delta = vbuy - vsell
vol = vbuy + vsell
a = sma(Math.pow(vol, 2), options.length)
b = Math.pow(sum(vol, options.length), 2) / Math.pow(options.length, 2)
sd = Math.sqrt(Math.max(a - b, 0))
thr = sma(vol, options.length) + options.mult * sd
bullAbs = (dir > 0 && delta < 0 && vol > thr) ? Math.abs(delta) : 0
bearAbs = (dir < 0 && delta > 0 && vol > thr) ? -Math.abs(delta) : 0
plothistogram({ time: time, value: bullAbs, color: options.bullColor }, title="Bull absorb")
plothistogram({ time: time, value: bearAbs, color: options.bearColor }, title="Bear absorb")
absorption.name: Absorption

liq-cascade.script:
// Highlights bars where total liquidations exceed mean + mult*stdev over the lookback.
// Overlaid on the base Liquidations histogram in bright colours.
// Up (magenta) = shorts liquidated, Down (yellow) = longs liquidated.
liqTot = lbuy + lsell
a = sma(Math.pow(liqTot, 2), options.length)
b = Math.pow(sum(liqTot, options.length), 2) / Math.pow(options.length, 2)
sd = Math.sqrt(Math.max(a - b, 0))
thr = sma(liqTot, options.length) + options.mult * sd
sig = liqTot > thr ? 1 : 0
plothistogram({ time: time, value: sig * lbuy, color: options.shortColor }, title="Short liq cascade")
plothistogram({ time: time, value: -sig * lsell, color: options.longColor }, title="Long liq cascade")
liq-cascade.name: Liq Cascade

spot-size-z.script:
// SIZE-BUCKET ACTIVITY, each bucket z-scored against ITS OWN recent history.
// A line at +2 means that bucket is buying two standard deviations harder than its normal, whatever its
// dollar size — so Big, Mid and Small are directly comparable on one axis. Cumulative CVDs show level and
// who is bigger; this shows who is being aggressive right now.
// Same adaptive buckets as the Big/Mid/Small CVDs (options.length / options.mult).
// Dotted lines at +/- options.hi sigma.
buy_vol = source(vbuy, type=spot)
buy_close = source(cbuy, type=spot)
buySize = buy_vol / Math.max(buy_close, 1)
sell_vol = source(vsell, type=spot)
sell_close = source(csell, type=spot)
sellSize = sell_vol / Math.max(sell_close, 1)
a_b = sma(Math.pow(buySize, 2), options.length)
b_b = Math.pow(sum(buySize, options.length), 2) / Math.pow(options.length, 2)
sd_b = Math.sqrt(Math.max(a_b - b_b, 0))
basis_b = sma(buySize, options.length)
up_b = basis_b + options.mult * sd_b
lo_b = basis_b - options.mult * sd_b
a_s = sma(Math.pow(sellSize, 2), options.length)
b_s = Math.pow(sum(sellSize, options.length), 2) / Math.pow(options.length, 2)
sd_s = Math.sqrt(Math.max(a_s - b_s, 0))
basis_s = sma(sellSize, options.length)
up_s = basis_s + options.mult * sd_s
lo_s = basis_s - options.mult * sd_s
bigFlow = (buySize > up_b ? buy_vol : 0) - (sellSize > up_s ? sell_vol : 0)
midFlow = ((buySize > lo_b) && (buySize < up_b) ? buy_vol : 0) - ((sellSize > lo_s) && (sellSize < up_s) ? sell_vol : 0)
smallFlow = (buySize < lo_b ? buy_vol : 0) - (sellSize < lo_s ? sell_vol : 0)
bigS = sma(bigFlow, options.smooth)
midS = sma(midFlow, options.smooth)
smallS = sma(smallFlow, options.smooth)
bigMean = sma(bigS, options.zwin)
bigSq = sma(bigS * bigS, options.zwin)
bigSd = Math.sqrt(Math.max(bigSq - bigMean * bigMean, 0))
bigZ = bigSd > 0 ? (bigS - bigMean) / bigSd : 0
midMean = sma(midS, options.zwin)
midSq = sma(midS * midS, options.zwin)
midSd = Math.sqrt(Math.max(midSq - midMean * midMean, 0))
midZ = midSd > 0 ? (midS - midMean) / midSd : 0
smallMean = sma(smallS, options.zwin)
smallSq = sma(smallS * smallS, options.zwin)
smallSd = Math.sqrt(Math.max(smallSq - smallMean * smallMean, 0))
smallZ = smallSd > 0 ? (smallS - smallMean) / smallSd : 0
var hiLine = options.hi
var loLine = 0 - options.hi
plotline(0, color=options.zeroColor)
plotline(hiLine, color=options.bandColor)
plotline(loLine, color=options.bandColor)
line(bigZ, color=options.bigColor, lineWidth=2, title="spot big z")
line(midZ, color=options.midColor, title="spot mid z")
line(smallZ, color=options.smallColor, title="spot small z")
spot-size-z.name: Spot Size Activity
